findings.title: Guard workflow shape before the new scope scan so readiness still publishes typed failure
requirement_basis: program-spec.md State/failure: validate malformed/ambiguous contracts visibly; no empty/default success; preserve exact diagnostic
tasks/intent.md T9 Failure contract: typed visible pending/stale/invalid/conflict/error
reviews/failure-classification.json O1 invalid-input guard: rejected input followed by corrected scoped reentry
findings.trigger: A generated workflow is valid JSON but has nodes:null. The existing readiness validator already recognizes non-list nodes and adds missing_workflow, but the new call passes the original malformed workflow to validate_scope.
findings.actual: validate_scope's any(...) executes before its try/except and raises TypeError. Readiness exits 1 with empty stdout and a traceback before --write-report runs. If an earlier report was ready, it remains byte-for-byte ready. Bootstrap likewise loses its normal structured diagnostic to the same new helper crash.
findings.expected: Return/publish a current not_ready report with a typed malformed-workflow/scope blocker and retain source/approved requirement records; correcting the workflow should restore readiness.
findings.fixed_base_comparison: The exact fixed-base readiness script on the same malformed fixture exits 1, prints and writes status:not_ready with code:missing_workflow and message:'workflow.json nodes must be a list'.
repro_steps: Run the independent fixture command in independent_runtime.fixture_generation_and_run_command.
On claude-docs, run copied validate_unattended_readiness.py <project> --write-report to establish ready.
Save workflow.json bytes; replace its content with {"nodes": null}; rerun the same command.
Observe empty stdout, TypeError in stderr, exit 1 and unchanged ready report. Compare the fixed-base script via git show as in regression_reproduction_command.
Restore the saved workflow and rerun; candidate is ready again.
findings.scope_note: This is a regression introduced in T9's common helper integration, not a demand for T10-T18 behavior. Preexisting check_decision_inputs malformed-container failure is not counted as a second new finding.
findings.suggested_repair: Validate workflow/node container types before scanning and route malformed values through the existing typed blocker path; add a focused copied-CLI regression including prior-ready report and corrected reentry. No repair was performed.

findings.title: Every new scoped-workflow node must have a valid in-scope requirement reference; unrelated empty-ref node is accepted
findings.expected: Reject new work with absent/empty requirement_refs; preserve actual unrelated historical completed branches. Do not forbid legitimate requirement-scoped prerequisite nodes.

scope: Same frozen T9 artifact paths and obligations; no new product decision, no later task implementation.
